stem: Which idea from the selection emphasizes the impact the Olympic symbol has had on others?

options.label: A
options.text: The Olympic symbol has five interlocking rings.

options.label: B
options.text: The Olympic symbol was developed by Coubertin to convey a message of unity.

options.label: C
options.text: The Olympic symbol is one of the most widely known logos on Earth.

options.label: D
